scenes.event: Ava and two coworkers meet for coffee to discuss an upcoming team project.
scenes.description: Ava sits with her two coworkers, Liam and Priya, in a cozy corner of a local café. They are discussing an upcoming team project for a client. The atmosphere is casual but focused, with the clinking of cups and soft background music.

characters.name: Ava Morales
characters.description: Ava is a 26-year-old young professional who is rational and humorous. She is focused on the project but subtly aware of her own emotional boundaries.; 26-year-old / Female / Single, 23 years old; Occupation: Young Professional; Personality: Rational, Humorous, Considerate, Reserved; Values: Emotional clarity, Friendship, Self-control; Interests: Late-night chats, Maintaining boundaries, Supporting friends; Experiences: Studying abroad, Cross-timezone friendships, Handling emotional dynamics
characters.position: Seated at the corner table, sipping a latte
characters.states: Relaxed on the surface, slightly uneasy inside

characters.name: Liam Chen
characters.description: Liam is a 28-year-old marketing strategist known for his bold ideas and easygoing nature; Male; Age: 28; Occupation: Digital Marketing Strategist; Personality: Energetic, creative, collaborative; Values: Innovation, teamwork, client satisfaction; Interests: Urban photography, indie music, coffee culture; Experiences: Successfully led a rebranding campaign for a startup, worked remotely during the pandemic to manage global client projects, frequently collaborates with cross-functional teams on creative initiatives.

characters.name: Priya Kapoor
characters.description: Priya is a 25-year-old graphic designer who is detail-oriented and empathetic. She often mediates between more outspoken team members; Female; Age: 25; Occupation: Graphic Designer; Personality: Empathetic, detail-oriented, diplomatic; Values: Team harmony, creativity, professionalism; Interests: Urban sketching, indie music, interior design; Experiences: Led a successful rebranding project for a local nonprofit, resolved a creative conflict between two senior designers, recently completed a certification in UX design.

actions.action: Shares his ideas for the project
actions.dialogue: I think we should focus on a bold, modern campaign. Let’s surprise the client with something they didn’t know they wanted!
That’s exciting, Liam, but we also need to make sure it aligns with their brand identity. Maybe a balance of creativity and consistency?
I agree with Priya. We should lay out a few clear options so they can feel in control. That way, we’re not just chasing wild ideas—we’re building a strategy they can trust.
Okay, okay, I’ll tone it down a bit. But we can still make it memorable. What do you think, Ava? You always have the best sense of what’s doable.
Doable? That’s a stretch. I prefer to think I just have a good poker face when it comes to bad ideas.
You do, but we all know you’re secretly the one keeping us from going off the rails.
Speaking of rails, has anyone been to Boracay? I heard it’s a place where people go to chase dreams or something.

actions.action: Reacting to the mention of Boracay
actions.dialogue: Oh, you mean Jack’s friend? He’s been talking about it a lot lately. You two know each other?
Just through Joy. I’ve been helping her keep Jack in check, you know, encouraging him to dream but not to overdo it.

actions.action: Changes the topic back to work
actions.dialogue: Let’s get back to the project. Liam, can you draft the initial concept? Ava, maybe you can help with the client’s expectations.

scenes.plot: Ava, Liam, and Priya are working on a team project and meet to plan. As they discuss, Ava subtly deflects a question about her connection to Jack, maintaining her emotional boundaries while supporting her friend’s journey.
scenes.social_purpose: To show how Ava’s values of emotional clarity and self-control influence her interactions, even in professional settings, and how she supports friendships without overstepping boundaries.

chunk.text: Ava, Liam, and Priya meet for coffee to plan a team project. Liam proposes a bold campaign, while Priya advocates for brand alignment. Ava adds a rational, humorous counterpoint and subtly shifts the conversation to Jack, who she knows through her friend Joy. She keeps the focus light and professional, avoiding deeper emotional discussions.
